text:
Elaine Castillo: Heads up — canary deploys are failing for a handful of orgs in EU region. Error looks like permission-gate denied: rollout.ops.canary.start
Samir Patel: seeing same in staging, logs show `403: missing permission rollout.ops.canary.start` right after we merged role refactor PR #3421
Lev Abramov: is that the RBAC mapping change that flattened service accounts? Could be a binding missing.
Ria Chen: @Samir can you paste the minimal log? Also, do we have any audit events for the denied checks?
Samir Patel: log snippet: `ERR auth: user=svc-rollout-eu action=rollout.ops.canary.start result=deny reason=role-mismatch request_id=rc-98321`
Samir Patel: audit search for rc-98321 returned nothing — looks like the authz decision isn't being logged for these attempts
Elaine Castillo: that matches reports from two customers. If audit isn't recording denies, that's bad for compliance.
security-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-003 (permission-gate: canary requests denied, missing audit entries)
incident-bot: Pager duty notified for oncall security and infra.
Ben Ortiz: quick theory: earlier KMS/IAM change swapped the service principal used to sign rollout tokens. If the token now contains an old role claim name, our policy engine might short-circuit and deny before audit logging hook runs.
Lev Abramov: confirmed — token for svc-rollout-eu has claim `roles: ["rollout:legacy"]` while policies expect `rollout:starter` after the refactor. Policy evaluator returns DENY early in evaluation order.
Ria Chen: so two things: (1) we need to adjust token signing to emit new role claim name (KMS side), (2) ensure audit logging is executed before short-circuit denies so denies are recorded.
Samir Patel: patch for evaluator ordering ready: https://git.redwood/rr/rollout-auth/pulls/128 — it moves audit hook earlier. Running unit tests now.
Elaine Castillo: good. Any risk that moving audit earlier will leak sensitive token contents to logs? We should redact
Ben Ortiz: audit hook already redacts bearer tokens and kms key ids, just include role name and decision. I'll double-check redaction rules.
Lev Abramov: small workaround to restore customer canaries: add an allow-binding for the old `rollout:legacy` claim to the canary role so those svc principals can still start canaries while we rotate tokens. We need it temporary and auditable.
Ria Chen: +1, but add TTL (48h) and log the exception in a rollout-audit:exceptions index.
Samir Patel: deployed hotfix binding to staging: `kubectl apply -f canary-legacy-binding.yaml` (binding has expiry annotation `rbac.redwood/expiry: 2026-03-22T12:00:00Z`)
Samir Patel: also started rolling update to KMS signer to emit `rollout:starter` claim — deployment in progress, waiting on key access test
Elaine Castillo: QA checklist before we close incident: reproduce deny -> audit entry exists, verify fallback policy triggers (fallback-to-stable) when canary.start denied, validate temporary binding expires automatically, verify no sensitive fields in audit records.
Ben Ortiz: note: fallback policy didn't trigger for first customer because deny happened before policy engine consulted fallback rules. Fixing evaluator ordering should address that.
Ria Chen: assigning follow-ups: @Samir patch rollout-auth PR, @Ben verify audit redaction and exceptions index, @Lev create terraform change for temporary binding with expiry tag, @Elaine coordinate customer comms.
Samir Patel: tests passing locally, pushing PR now. I'll also add an integration test that simulates old claim -> ensure audit logged and fallback applied.
Lev Abramov: I'll open infra PR to add the temporary binding to prod with the expiry annotation and a note in the change description.
Elaine Castillo: thanks team. If anyone hits a blocker ping me directly. :thumbsup:
Samir Patel: quick command I used to repro locally:
```
HTTP/1.1 POST /api/v1/rollouts/canary
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJ... (derived token with roles:["rollout:legacy"])
{"service":"svc-rollout-eu","image":"..."}
```
Samir Patel: response `403 {"error":"permission denied","code":"rollout.ops.canary.start"}`
Ben Ortiz: once PR is merged I'll run canary smoke across EU and NA.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-003 status updated to INVESTIGATING -> MITIGATING
Elaine Castillo: recorded notes in incident board. Will update customers once hotfix and binding are in place.
Samir Patel: PR merged, hotfix deployed to prod, temporary binding applied with expiry tag. Running smoke.
Ben Ortiz: smoke green for EU group A, audit entries present for deny+allow, redaction verified.
Ria Chen: closing checklist: migration of KMS signer to new claim name scheduled, temp-binding TTL enforced, evaluator ordering change reverted to final design after rollout.
Elaine Castillo: closing incident after 2h remediation. Thanks all. :party:
